$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：廉貞天相坐子午，p.108–110。原書廉貞化忌、羊陀火鈴一段講到輕生，唔入讀者句；只保留「內心脆弱、無人傾訴」並加一句找人說出來。

basis.quote: 须详其为则毅，抑为脆弱

rules.text: 你的廉貞化祿，會｛昌曲｝而不見火鈴：秉性剛毅，外表平和，外圓內方；是非雖多，仍能應付得體。
rules.en: Your Lian Zhen is transformed by Lu, meets ｛Chang or Qu｝, and avoids Huo and Ling: firm by nature, calm in manner, round outside and square within; though disputes come, you handle them well.

rules.text: 你的廉貞化忌，內心較脆弱：順境時只是一時苦悶，逆境時卻覺得百般不足，又找不到人傾訴；遇到難處，記得找人說出來。
rules.en: Your Lian Zhen is in Obstruction, which leaves you more fragile inside: in good times it's only passing gloom, but in hard times everything feels lacking and there seems to be no one to talk to; when things get hard, remember to reach out.
rules.edit: 原句續講火鈴空劫時「自我毀滅」，不用；末句建議係編輯加的。

rules.text: 擎羊同宮或對照，令你內心較脆弱，也容易因此招惹是非。
rules.en: Qing Yang in your palace or opposite it leaves you more fragile inside, and more likely to stir up disputes because of it.

rules.text: 祿存同宮或對照，令你的情緒祥和：雖少突破性的發展，也能應付環境的變化。
rules.en: Lu Cun in your palace or opposite it brings a calmer temper: few breakthroughs, but you cope with whatever changes come.

rules.text: 對面遷移宮的破軍化祿，又有〔吉星〕會合，令你剛毅。
rules.en: Po Jun opposite you is transformed by Lu and joined by 〔favourable stars〕, which makes you firm.

source.quote: 则可使[廉相]得刚毅之性

rules.text: 剛毅的你，不怕變化幅度大的運；即使煞忌並見，也能否極泰來。
rules.en: Being the resolute kind, you need not fear phases of sweeping change; even when harsh stars gather, the bad turns to good.

source.quote: 亦可得否极泰来的际遇

rules.text: 柔軟的你，喜行星曜平和的運，就能安於現狀、守住所得。
rules.en: Being the gentler kind, you do well in calm, even-tempered phases, where you can settle in and keep what you have.

source.quote: 则能安于现状，或持盈保泰
